title: Veteran Coach Assistant (VCA)
description:
Position Summary



The Veteran Coach Assistant (VCA) is the operational partner of the Veteran Coach, ensuring every veteran receives a seamless, organized, and timely experience throughout the claims process. This role is responsible for managing workflows, maintaining accurate documentation, coordinating appointments, tracking follow-ups, and ensuring no veteran or task falls through the cracks.



The Veteran Coach Assistant primarily focuses on operational support and account management. However, when business needs require, the VCA is fully cross-trained and may assume the responsibilities of a Veteran Call Coach, conducting veteran outreach and onboarding while maintaining service quality and continuity.

 

Key Responsibilities



Veteran Account Management

• Manage veteran accounts before, during, and after Veteran Call Coach outreach. 

• Review account history, lead source, ownership, previous notes, and current workflow before veteran engagement. 

• Ensure every veteran account progresses through the correct workflow and status. 

• Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records. 



Documentation & Workflow Administration

• Document all veteran interactions accurately and promptly. 

• Track: 

o Contact attempts 

o Call outcomes 

o Lead source 

o Warm/cold status 

o Callback schedules 

o Consultation status 

o Next action items 

• Ensure documentation meets company quality standards. 

• Maintain consistent workflow terminology and account organization. 



Scheduling & Follow-Up Coordination

• Schedule consultations, follow-up calls, and appointments. 

• Send reminders and written next steps to veterans when appropriate. 

• Coordinate follow-up activities between departments. 

• Ensure veterans never miss important appointments or deadlines. 



Call Coach Support

• Prepare accounts for Veteran Call Coach outreach. 

• Review post-call summaries and complete required administrative actions. 

• Update CRM records, schedule follow-ups, and move accounts through the appropriate workflow. 

• Identify missing information or incomplete next steps before they become service issues. 

• Escalate sensitive or complex matters requiring leadership attention. 



Cross-Functional Veteran Support

• Serve as the operational extension of the Veteran Call Coach to ensure continuity of care. 

• Collaborate with other departments to keep veteran cases progressing efficiently. 

• Help maintain one consistent veteran experience from initial contact through onboarding. 



Veteran Coach (As Needed)

• Conduct veteran outreach, onboarding, and follow-up calls when operational needs require. 

• Perform Veteran Call Coach responsibilities during staffing shortages, overflow periods, schedule coverage, or other business demands. 

• Deliver the same level of professionalism, empathy, and communication expected of a Veteran Call Coach. 

• Transition veterans back to the assigned Call Coach while ensuring complete documentation and continuity of care. 

 

Core Responsibilities

• CRM and account management 

• Lead workflow administration 

• Documentation and quality control 

• Scheduling and appointment coordination 

• Veteran follow-up management 

• Administrative support 

• Cross-functional communication

description:
ABOUT US

 

We're a US-based financial planning firm. We publish a lot of educational content (YouTube videos, webinars,
 newsletters, and social media) for Americans who are approaching retirement. Our audience is older, thoughtful, and asks a lot of good questions.

 

Our marketing team is small and growing. We're looking for someone dependable to handle the day-to-day work that keeps everything running, so the team can focus on creating.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 

- Responding to social media comments. We'll give you a library of approved replies for the questions people ask most often. Your job is to respond promptly, politely, and consistently, and to flag anything unusual for us rather than guessing.

 

- Moderating our social accounts. Hiding spam, reporting fake accounts impersonating our company, and keeping our comment sections clean.

 

- Scheduling posts. Publishing content across our social platforms from a calendar we'll give you.

 

- Helping with webinars and
. Setting up registration pages, loading
 copy into templates, checking that links work, and scheduling sends. We'll train you on our tools.

 

- Keeping things organized. Uploading and labeling video files and images, following our file-naming conventions, maintaining simple trackers.

 

- Light reporting. Pulling a few numbers each week into a standing report.

 

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

Required:

 

- Excellent written English. This is the most important requirement. You'll be writing replies that American readers see publicly, so your writing needs to be clear, warm, and error-free.

 

- Comfortable on social media platforms,
, Instagram, and YouTube at minimum. You should know your way around comments, posts, and basic account settings.

 

- Comfortable learning new software. We use HubSpot, WebinarGeek, and a few other tools. You do not need to know any of them already. You do need to be the kind of person who can watch a tutorial, read a help doc, and figure things out.

 

- Detail-oriented and reliable. Much of this job is doing small things correctly and consistently. If you're the person who notices the broken link or the typo, we want to talk to you.

 

- Good judgment about when to ask. We'd much rather you ask a question than guess.

 

- Reliable internet and a backup option, plus availability during our morning hours.



HOW TO APPLY

 

We read every application that follows these instructions.

title: Sales Floor Accountability Manager (Remote VA) — Lead Response Enforcement
description:
ABOUT US 🏠



We install whole-home water filtration and softening systems for homeowners across South Florida. About 30 installs a month at an average of $3,400 per job. Every lead costs us real money.



When a lead comes in and nobody calls it for two hours, that money is gone. That's the problem you're hired to kill.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE ⏱️



Every lead gets contacted within 60 seconds. You are the person who makes sure that happens — every time, every rep, every day.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Watch the lead queue live during your entire shift. New lead hits, your clock starts.

Track the 60-second window on every single lead assigned to a rep

Miss at 60 seconds → you immediately message the rep: "Lead #X is unworked. What's happening?"

No reply within 2 minutes → you pull the lead and reassign it to the next available rep online

Log every miss: which rep, which lead, how late, what the excuse was

Send the owner a daily scoreboard — response times by rep, misses, reassignments

Send a weekly report showing who's improving and who isn't

Flag repeat offenders to the owner. Same rep, same excuse, three times? Owner hears about it that day.

Confirm reps are actually logged in and available at the start of every shift



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT 🚫



You are not a salesperson. You don't close.

You are not a coach. You don't train reps.

You are not their friend. You're the referee.



You are the person who makes a grown adult uncomfortable about being late. If that sounds bad to you, don't apply.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR ✅



Required:



Thick skin. Reps will push back, make excuses, get annoyed at you. You hold the line anyway.

Obsessive about time. Seconds matter here, not minutes.

Comfortable holding adults accountable over chat and phone

Excellent written and spoken English

2+ years in operations, dispatch, team lead, QA, or a similar tracking role

You can sit on a live dashboard for hours without drifting

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

Available Sunday-Saturday 8 AM – 11 PM US Eastern Time (that's when leads come in, you won't be working every single hour of the day, the calls are scattered, we get around 10-15 leads daily and have 5 sales reps)



Nice to have:



Spanish

GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar CRM

Call center floor manager or dispatcher background

Home services, HVAC, plumbing, or roofing experience

title: Creator Partnerships & Production Coordinator Remote
description:
6FT CLUB® is a men’s confidence and footwear brand based in Los Angeles. We are hiring a highly organized, proactive Production Coordinator to help us consistently find creators, coordinate product-content shoots, and manage creator partnerships from outreach through final delivery. This is not a general administrative assistant position. Your primary responsibility will be helping us produce a reliable stream of high-quality video content featuring our height-increasing insoles and shoes. 



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:



1) Coordinate Los Angeles Studio Shoots



Our height-increase shoes are stored at our creative studio in Downtown Los Angeles and cannot be mailed to creators. 



You will: 

Find male models, actors, UGC creators, and lifestyle creators located in the Los Angeles area. 

Identify talent who can travel to our DTLA studio. 

Contact candidates and confirm their interest, rates, availability, clothing sizes, and shoe sizes. 

Coordinate shoot dates between the brand owner, studio availability, creators, photographers, and videographers. 

Send confirmations, call sheets, reference images, shot lists, and reminders. 

Maintain backup talent in case someone cancels. 

Help make sure each shoot is properly prepared before anyone arrives. 

Track payments, content deliverables, releases, and usage rights. 



You will coordinate these shoots remotely from the Philippines. You will not be expected to attend them in person. 



2) Recruit U.S.-Based UGC Creators



Our height-increase insoles can be mailed to creators throughout the United States. 



You will: 

Find TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and UGC creators who match the brand. 

Conduct personalized outreach through
 and direct messages. 

Explain the collaboration and negotiate reasonable creator rates. 

Collect shipping information and product-size requirements. 

Coordinate product shipment with our team. 

Provide creators with clear briefs, references, deadlines, and talking points. 

Follow up until the content is delivered. 

Organize finished content, creator information, agreements, and usage rights. 

Build ongoing relationships with reliable creators. 



3) Evaluate Brand Fit



Our ideal audience includes men interested in confidence, dating, style, fitness, grooming, self-improvement, and personal presentation. 



Strong creator candidates will generally be: 

Male, approximately 21–35 years old. 

Based in the United States. 

Comfortable creating authentic, natural short-form video. 

Visually aligned with a modern men’s lifestyle brand. 

Able to communicate the product benefit without making the content feel embarrassing, deceptive, or overly promotional. 

Followed by an audience that includes young professionals and men interested in improving their appearance and confidence. 

Many of our customers are Latino and Asian men, but creators from all backgrounds should be considered when they naturally fit the brand.

Follower count is less important than content quality, audience fit, communication, and reliability. We are generally interested in creators with approximately 10,000–150,000 followers, as well as talented UGC creators who may have smaller audiences. 

Creators with an Amazon Storefront or experience producing Amazon video content are especially valuable. 



REQUIRED SKILLS

--------------------------------------

Strong written English. 

Excellent organization and follow-up. 

Experience with influencer outreach, UGC coordination, talent sourcing, social-media research, casting, or production coordination. 

Comfortable communicating with creators through
, TikTok, Instagram, and other platforms. 

Able to evaluate whether a creator genuinely fits a brand. 

Able to manage several creator conversations and deadlines simultaneously. 

Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Drive, Notion, and project-management tools. 

Proactive and capable of moving projects forward without waiting for instructions every day. 

Detail-oriented when recording rates, deliverables, product sizes, deadlines, and contact information. 



WORKING HOURS

--------------------------------------

This is a part-time remote position of approximately 20 hours per week. 

Most work can be completed during normal daytime hours, but you must have some availability overlapping with Los Angeles business hours for creator communication, scheduling, and occasional meetings. We can establish predictable overlap hours rather than requiring you to remain online throughout the U.S. workday. 



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

--------------------------------------

Within your first 60–90 days, you should be able to: 

Build an organized database of qualified creators. 

Maintain a steady outreach pipeline. 

Present a shortlist of genuinely brand-appropriate candidates each week. 

Consistently move creators from initial contact to confirmed collaboration. 

Coordinate Los Angeles studio shoots with minimal scheduling confusion. 

Reduce cancellations through confirmations and backup talent.

Track every creator, negotiation, shipment, deadline, deliverable, and usage agreement. 

Identify dependable creators we can hire repeatedly. 



COMPENSATION

--------------------------------------

Starting compensation will depend on experience and availability. We anticipate approximately 400 to 500 USD per month for 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase compensation based on performance and expanded responsibilities. 

This role may begin with a paid trial period. 



HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------

Please include the following: 

A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience. 

Examples of creator outreach, influencer marketing, casting, talent coordination, or production work you have completed. 

The tools you have used to find and manage creators. 

Your expected monthly salary for 20 hours per week. 

Your availability for overlap with Los Angeles business hours. 

A sample link to one TikTok or Instagram creator you believe would be a strong fit for 6FT CLUB®, along with two or three sentences explaining why. 

The word “ELEVATE” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete listing.

title: Part-Time Unity Game Developer – Long-Term Indie Game Project (HabitQuest)
description:
About the Project:



I'm looking for a Unity developer to help me continue building an indie game called HabitQuest.



HabitQuest is a game that turns real-world habits, goals, and personal development into RPG progression. The idea is that activities you complete in real life improve attributes and unlock progress inside the game.



This is not just an idea or a game design document. I already have a working Unity prototype.



The current prototype includes a splash screen, navigation between areas/NPCs, a basic character/progression concept, and a playable 2D tower-defense minigame. I am building it in Unity for mobile, primarily Android initially.



The prototype is rough, but the core concept is working.





What I'm Looking For:



I'm looking for a Filipino Unity developer who would be interested in working on HabitQuest with me long term, rather than completing one small freelance job and disappearing.



I am currently a full-time neuroscience PhD student, so my available development time is limited. I need someone who can take clearly defined features, work independently, communicate when there are problems, and steadily improve the game.



I don't expect you to know everything. I care much more about reliability, communication, problem-solving ability, and actually completing features.





You should be comfortable working with:



• Unity

• C#

• 2D games

• UI and menus

• Prefabs and ScriptableObjects

• Game mechanics and progression systems

• Debugging existing Unity projects

• Git or another version-control system



Experience developing Android/mobile games, RPG systems, tower-defense games, multiplayer systems, APIs, or AI integration would be a major plus, but is not required.





How We Will Work:



I want to begin with a paid two-week trial project.



I will give you access to the existing HabitQuest project and a clearly defined feature or group of features to implement. During those two weeks, I'm mainly evaluating:



• Quality of work

• Ability to understand an existing Unity project

• Communication

• Reliability

• Ability to solve problems independently

• Whether we enjoy working together



If the trial goes well, I would like to continue at approximately 10 hours per week / $500 USD per month.



The schedule can be flexible. I care much more about consistent progress than what hours you work.



I would like to have one video call each week where we review what was completed, look at the game together, discuss problems, and decide what should be built next.



I want the development process to be transparent. Code will be maintained in the project's repository, and I should always be able to see what has been completed and what is currently being worked on.





Potential Long-Term Opportunity:



I'm specifically looking for someone who might become genuinely invested in HabitQuest over time.



If we work together successfully for an extended period, you become an important part of developing the game, and HabitQuest eventually generates revenue, I would be open to discussing a small profit-sharing arrangement in addition to your normal pay.



I'm not asking anyone to work for free or in exchange for hypothetical future profits. The position is paid. Profit sharing would only be an additional opportunity for the right long-term person.





Communication:



Good spoken and written English is important because we will be discussing game mechanics and new ideas together.



You should also be comfortable telling me:



“I don't understand this.”



“I think there is a better way to build this.”



or



“This feature will take longer than expected because of X.”



I would much rather hear about a problem early than discover several weeks later that no progress was made.





Compensation:



Initial two-week paid trial: approximately 20 hours / $250 USD

Ongoing part-time work after a successful trial: approximately 10 hours per week / $500 USD per month



I care more about consistent progress and communication than rigid work hours.





How to Apply:



Please send me,



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. How long you have been developing games with Unity.

3. Links, screenshots, videos, or playable examples of Unity games you have personally worked on.

4. For each project you show me, briefly explain what you personally programmed or created.

5. Your experience with C#.

6. Whether you have experience developing Unity games for Android/mobile.

7. Your normal weekly availability. (include what day/times you can meet on zoom)

8. A link to GitHub or another code portfolio if you have one.



9. Please also send a short 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and showing me one Unity project you have worked on.

     -It doesn't need to be professionally produced. A simple Loom recording, screen recording, or phone/video introduction is fine.

    -Show me something you built and briefly explain:

     a. What did you build, what was difficult about it, and how did you solve the problem?



This is important because I'm looking for someone I can communicate and collaborate with regularly, not just someone who can write code.



Finally, please begin your application with the words:



“I read the HabitQuest description.”



Applications that do not include that sentence may not be reviewed.



Thanks for reading. I'm looking forward to meeting some talented developers and hopefully finding someone who wants to help build this project with me for a long time.

title: Content Marketing
description:
About the Role

We're a boutique interior design studio based in Jupiter, Florida, looking to grow our reach and generate more qualified leads. We're hiring a part-time, remote Marketing & Content Coordinator to own our organic content,
 marketing, and online presence — turning our project photography into consistent, high-quality content across our website, blog, Houzz, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and
 list. This is a long-term, ongoing part-time role (not a short-term project) for the right person.

What You'll Own

• Website & SEO blog: write and publish blog posts optimized for local and design-related search terms (e.g. “Jupiter, FL interior designer,” room-specific design guides), aimed at driving organic traffic and leads.

• Houzz: maintain and grow our Houzz profile — upload new project photos, manage Ideabooks, keep our Houzz blog updated, and respond to inquiries and reviews.

• Pinterest: build and maintain boards from our project photography, pin consistently, and optimize for long-term search traffic.

• LinkedIn: post regularly to build visibility with potential referral partners (realtors, builders, architects) as well as prospective clients.

•
 marketing: write and send our newsletter on a consistent cadence, grow our subscriber list (e.g. via a lead magnet and landing page), and set up basic nurture/welcome automation.

• Website updates & conversion: keep site content current (services, project galleries, testimonials, contact details) and improve how well the site turns visitors into inquiries — simplifying the contact form, strengthening calls-to-action, and reducing friction in the path to “book a consultation.”

• Brand & niche consistency: keep blog, social, and
 content aligned with our design niche and target client profile across every channel.

• Content repurposing: turn project photos and footage captured by our in-house team into content across blog, Houzz, Pinterest, and
 — no on-site presence required.

• Reporting: track inquiries/leads generated by channel and share a simple monthly summary of what's working.

• Light coordination with our existing Meta ads freelancer to keep messaging and creative aligned with organic content.

Press, Awards & Reputation

• Magazine features: track editorial calendars and “call for submissions” from regional/trade design publications, assemble project packages (photos + write-up) from our existing photography, and submit for feature consideration.

• Award submissions: research and submit projects to relevant local/regional design awards (e.g. ASID or NKBA chapter awards, “Best of” programs).

• Testimonials & case studies: after each project wraps, collect a written or short video testimonial and turn the project into a case study, then publish across the blog, Houzz, Pinterest, and
.

• Reviews: run a consistent post-project workflow requesting Google and Houzz reviews from happy clients.

• Guest content & podcasts: pitch guest blog posts to relevant design/lifestyle sites, invite local industry experts to contribute to our blog, and pitch us as a guest on regional design or lifestyle podcasts.

• Directory listings: keep our profile complete and consistent (name, address, phone, photos) across Houzz and other relevant local directories.

• Local collaborations: identify and help coordinate collaborations with local lifestyle/home influencers or content creators (e.g. home tours, features) — coordination only, not content creation.

What's Not in Scope (For Now)

• Instagram content creation and posting — this is currently handled in-house since it requires on-site filming/photography. May be added to this role later as it evolves.

• Paid ad management (Meta/Google) — handled by a separate freelancer.

What We're Looking For

• Excellent written English — our brand voice matters, especially for blog and
 content.

• Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals (keyword research, on-page optimization).

• Experience managing Houzz and/or Pinterest for a design, home services, or real estate business is a strong plus.

• Comfort with
 marketing platforms (e.g. Mailchimp) and basic automation.

• Familiarity with Wix or a similar website CMS.

• Highly organized and self-directed — able to manage a content calendar across multiple channels with minimal oversight.

• Reliable internet connection and availability for some overlap with US Eastern time for check-ins.

Details

• Hours: 25–30 hours/week, ongoing part-time (potential to grow over time based on fit and results).

• Location: Remote / overseas candidates welcome.

• Reports to: Studio owner and Operations Coordinator

How to Apply

Please include a short cover note along with the following:

• 2–3 writing samples — published blog posts, articles, or
 campaigns (links preferred over attachments).

• Examples of Houzz and/or Pinterest profiles you've managed (links or screenshots), ideally for a design, home services, or real estate business.

• Any examples of press/media placements or award submissions you've helped coordinate, if applicable.

Strong candidates may be asked to complete a short, sample task (e.g. a draft blog post based on one of our projects) before a final decision, so we can evaluate fit for our brand voice.

title: Insurance Administration & Compliance Support | Australian Brokerage
description:
We are an Australian general insurance brokerage looking for a detail-oriented support professional to help our brokers keep client files organised, reconcile payments and manage policy administration.



This is an administrative, non-advice role. You will work under broker supervision and follow documented processes. Brokers retain responsibility for advice, recommendations, approvals and placement decisions.



WORK ARRANGEMENT AND PAY

Remote, Philippines-based. Full-time, 40 hours per week during Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

Salary: PHP 45,000-67,500 per month, depending on relevant experience and skills.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Reconcile insurer and network remittance reports against policy invoices and CRM records. Check policy numbers, client names, transaction types and commission amounts, identify discrepancies and maintain a clear exception list.

- Organise compliance files for new business, renewals and endorsements. Collect and correctly file quote
s, client acceptance, policy schedules, invoices, certificates and other required evidence.

- Check documents and records against checklists, identify missing or inconsistent information and follow up with the relevant team member. Escalate anything unclear rather than guessing.

- Keep CRM and broking-system records accurate, including policy details, file notes, products, activities and renewal reminders.

- Prepare files for broker review and track outstanding compliance actions. Only progress policy stages when the required checks and broker approvals are complete.

- Assist brokers with endorsements, policy changes, renewals, document requests, follow-ups and other day-to-day administrative tasks.

- Maintain organised electronic client folders and clear handover notes so another team member can readily understand the status of each file.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Experience in insurance administration, broker support, financial-services administration or a closely related detail-heavy support role.

- Strong accuracy with spreadsheets, numbers, document comparison and data entry.

- Excellent written English and clear professional communication.

- An organised approach to competing priorities, follow-ups and deadlines.

- Good judgement about when to follow a process and when to escalate an exception.

- Respect for confidentiality and secure handling of client information.

- Reliable computer, internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.



HIGHLY REGARDED

- Experience supporting an Australian general insurance brokerage.

- Experience with SCTP, Sunrise and similar insurance quoting and policy administration platforms.

- Experience with payment or commission reconciliation, compliance file preparation, endorsements and renewals.

- Knowledge of general insurance products such as business insurance, public liability, professional indemnity, property, landlord and commercial motor insurance. General insurance experience is particularly relevant; this is not a life insurance sales role.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. Your CV and a short summary of relevant insurance or administration experience.

2. The systems you have used and your level of experience with spreadsheets.

3. An example of a payment discrepancy or incomplete file you identified, how you checked it and when you escalated it. Use an anonymised example without client information.

4. Your availability, earliest start date and expected monthly salary in PHP.

5. A short answer to this scenario: a remittance shows a payment, but the CRM amount differs and the compliance file is incomplete. What would you check, and what would you avoid changing until clarified?



We value careful, reliable work and clear communication. Please do not include confidential client records or documents in your application.

title: Limousine / Black-Car Dispatcher (Live Trip Dispatch, WhatsApp + Google Sheets) - Tri-State NYC Experience Preferred
description:
Empire Black Truck is a fast-paced limousine and black-car transportation company serving the New York Tri-State area. Trips are posted in WhatsApp groups throughout the day and can be claimed by another company within seconds, so our dispatchers have to stay focused, react quickly, and make fast but accurate decisions.



This is a live-operations role. If you enjoy fast decisions, constant coordination and keeping every trip and every dollar accounted for, you will do well here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1) Claim jobs fast, and only the right ones

- Monitor multiple WhatsApp groups where transportation jobs are posted all day.

- Before accepting a job, immediately check our drivers' live locations, current assignments and upcoming schedules to confirm we can cover it.

- Accept and claim jobs within seconds when we can cover them.



2) Assign and confirm

- Assign or pre-book the appropriate driver for each accepted job.

- Send the complete trip information to the driver and confirm the driver received and acknowledged it.

- Check for scheduling conflicts and prevent double bookings.



3) Monitor every active trip

- Track each trip in real time: driver on location, passenger on board, trip completed.

- If a driver is late, unresponsive or has an issue, act immediately: contact the driver, update the appropriate person, and arrange backup coverage when needed.

- Handle airport pickups, flight delays and last-minute schedule changes calmly.



4) Keep the tracking sheet perfect

Every job must be entered into our Google Sheets tracker with:

- Trip date and time

- Pickup and drop-off locations

- Passenger information

- Assigned driver

- Company that provided the job, and the specific dispatcher who sent it

- Total job amount, driver pay, expected profit

- Payment terms, due date, and payment status (paid, pending or late)

This is how we know exactly who gave us each job and who we need to follow up with for payment, so accuracy is not optional.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required

- Previous dispatch or live-operations experience in a fast-paced, last-mile environment.

- Excellent spoken and written English; you will be communicating with drivers, affiliates and clients constantly.

- Strong internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) with a backup connection, plus a backup power source. You must be reachable at all times during your shift.

- Comfortable working U.S. Eastern Time hours, including early mornings, evenings or weekends depending on the shift assigned.

- Confident with WhatsApp (groups, voice notes, quick replies) and Google Sheets (data entry, filters, formulas at a basic level).

- Calm under pressure, extremely organized, and able to make quick decisions without waiting to be told.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in limousine, black-car, taxi/rideshare, NEMT, airport transportation, courier, or food-delivery dispatch.

- Working knowledge of the New York Tri-State area: JFK, LGA, EWR, Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Westchester, Long Island, New Jersey and Connecticut - including typical drive times and traffic patterns.

- Experience dispatching from affiliate networks or job-posting groups where trips are claimed first-come, first-served.

- Familiarity with limo/black-car software or booking platforms.



Please note: 3PL trucking, truckload scheduling and HVAC dispatch experience can be helpful, but those industries operate very differently from limousine and taxi dispatch. If your background is only in those areas, please explain clearly in your application how you would handle live passenger transportation, airport pickups and jobs that must be claimed within seconds.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply with the subject line: BLACK CAR DISPATCHER - [YOUR NAME]



In your application, answer all of the following. Applications that do not answer every question will not be reviewed.

1. Describe your dispatch experience. What industry, how many drivers/trips per day, and what tools did you use?

2. Have you dispatched passenger transportation (limo, black car, taxi, NEMT, airport)? Give one specific example of a problem trip and how you solved it.

3. A trip is posted in a WhatsApp group: JFK pickup at 6:00 PM today, drop-off in Midtown Manhattan. Walk us through, step by step, exactly what you check and do in the first 60 seconds.

4. Attach a screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net) taken on the connection you would use for work, and tell us your backup internet and backup power setup.

5. What hours are you available in U.S. Eastern Time?

6. How familiar are you with the NYC Tri-State area? Roughly how long is JFK to Midtown at 5:00 PM on a weekday?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid live-dispatch trial (WhatsApp + Google Sheets) before hiring.

title: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)
description:
Role: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time (Flexible: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM PST Part-Time or 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST Full-Time)

Start Date: Immediate





Compensation & Career Progression:

We believe in supporting you while you build your pipeline, offering guaranteed baseline pay during onboarding and a transparent pathway to step into a high-earning, full-cycle closing role as you gain experience.



• Stage 1 — Onboarding Setter Track:

o Competitive Guaranteed Base Pay ($3.00 – $3.50+ USD / hour, negotiable based on outbound B2B experience)

o +$30 – $50 bonus for every qualified appointment that turns into a closed deal

o Guaranteed income while you learn our niche, build lead lists, and master the outreach script.

• Stage 2 — Performance Commission (Setting Track):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o 10% – 12% of project value ($50 – $200+ per deal, based on website scopes starting at $500+) when you source the lead, book the discovery call, and we close the sale.



• Stage 3 — Full-Cycle Closer Track (Promotion Opportunity):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o Up to 20% – 25% of total project revenue ($100 – $500+ per closed client).

o Unlocked once you master our offer and take over running website audits, sales presentations, and closing client agreements directly.

o Target monthly earnings: $1,200 – $2,500+ USD (uncapped).

• Payouts: Paid on time, bi-weekly via Wise or Revolut.





Job Overview



We build modern, high-converting websites for small and medium-sized local businesses across the United States. We are looking for an ambitious, ethical, and resourceful B2B Sales Specialist.

You will start by identifying local businesses with strong community reputations (4.0+ stars on Google Maps and Yelp) that currently lack an active or modern website, reaching out to owners, and booking them for complimentary digital audits. As you become proficient with our solutions and objections, you will have the opportunity to run the sales calls yourself and close deals end-to-end.



Key Responsibilities



• Reputation-First Prospecting: Search Google Maps and Yelp for established local businesses (contractors, trades, auto services, specialty clinics, local dining) with strong ratings that have no website, broken links, or outdated pages.

• Need Qualification: Verify that the business is active, healthy, and would genuinely profit from an inbound web presence.

• Decision-Maker Discovery: Track down the actual owner or principal decision-maker using public records, social platforms, and brief verification calls.

• Multi-Touch Outreach: Execute cold calls, personalized follow-up
s, and direct messaging using our conversational, non-pushy outreach frameworks.

• Pipeline Management: Schedule qualified business owners onto the discovery calendar, maintain organized CRM records, and prepare to transition into running product walkthroughs and closing deals.

Candidate Requirements

• B2B Cold Outreach Experience: 1+ years of outbound calling, cold outreach, or appointment setting targeting US or North American business owners.

• Conversational English Fluency: Professional, natural verbal communication with clear tonality on US phone lines.

• Consultative Ethics: We sell real solutions to businesses with clear digital gaps—no high-pressure or misleading tactics.

• Growth Ambition: Eager to develop beyond basic appointment setting into a full-cycle sales professional who presents offers and closes contracts.

• Schedule Alignment: Reliable availability during core US Pacific business hours.

Technical Setup Requirements

• Hardware: Dedicated laptop or PC (minimum Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3, 8 GB RAM).

• Connectivity: Stable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) plus a mandatory mobile data / hotspot backup.

• Audio/Video: Dedicated noise-canceling USB headset and a functional webcam for internal team check-ins.

• Environment: Quiet, distraction-free home office setup.



How to Apply



To confirm your attention to detail, include this format in your application exactly as:

[Your Full Name] - Web Sales Specialist - 0904





Submit your application with the following:



1. Your updated resume highlighting your outbound sales and appointment-setting experience.

2. A short (60–90 second) Loom video or audio recording covering:

o How you determine whether a business with no website is actually a good sales prospect.

o How you navigate past gatekeepers to speak directly with the owner.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed test.

title: Personal Assistant, Social Media Management
description:
Hey 👋

I run an AI content agency and I'm looking for a personal assistant to work closely with me and keep things running smoothly.



What the role actually is



You'll be posting videos to social media accounts using virtual phones, for both our own brands and our clients' brands. Alongside that you'll help me with general assistant work and coordinate with my editors so nothing falls through the cracks.



What the role is not



To be completely clear, this is not a content creation role. You won't be making videos or writing scripts. This is a personal assistant position focused on posting and keeping the agency organised.



Hours and schedule



15 hours a week, Monday to Sunday. Posting happens every day, so it works out at roughly 2 hours daily. Time off is absolutely fine, I just need it arranged in advance so posting is covered.



Pay



$2 per hour, and I want to be upfront that this is fixed. The work itself is straightforward, which is why the rate is what it is. Please only apply if that genuinely works for you.



Who I'm looking for



Someone seriously dedicated. Someone who takes pride in being reliable and doesn't need chasing.



I care far more about attitude than experience here. If you're hardworking, communicative and genuinely want to help the agency grow, you'll do well. The tasks are simple but they need doing properly and consistently, every single day.



Room to grow



I'm building this agency and I want people who grow with it. If you're brilliant at this, there's real scope to take on more over time.



How to apply



Tell me in a few sentences why you'd be good at this and what your daily schedule looks like.



Looking forward to hearing from you 🙏

title: Media Buyer Needed
description:
Media Buyer Needed — Manage 30+ Meta Ad Accounts for School Marketing Campaigns (Philippines)



We're a Miami-based enrollment marketing agency working exclusively with charter and private schools across the U.S. We run Meta ad campaigns for our school clients, each spending roughly $50–$100/day, and we need a dedicated media buyer to manage a portfolio of ~30 of these accounts.



This is not a high-budget, e-commerce-style media buying role. You won't be managing six-figure monthly ad spend or experimenting with cutting-edge scaling strategies. This role is about consistency, precision, and follow-through — launching campaigns correctly, monitoring performance daily, adjusting for CPL/CPC, and keeping every account on track without things falling through the cracks.



What you'll be doing:

Launching and managing Meta ad campaigns across ~30 school client accounts

Monitoring KPIs (CPL, CPC, CTR, budget pacing) and making optimization decisions

Writing creative briefs for our internal creative team based on campaign performance and market/audience insight

Following our pre-launch approval process (all changes require written sign-off via 
/Slack before going live)

Managing budgets exactly as approved — no unauthorized changes

Reporting on account performance at agreed intervals

Flagging underperforming accounts proactively, before they become client-facing problems

Working inside GoHighLevel and 
 daily



You qualify if:

You have hands-on experience managing multiple Meta ad accounts simultaneously (5+ preferred)

You have real GoHighLevel experience — not just familiarity, actual working knowledge

You're comfortable with repetitive, process-driven work and don't need variety to stay engaged

You follow instructions precisely and don't launch anything without approval

You respond to messages within the same business day, every time

You can look at a KPI dashboard and immediately know what's underperforming and why

You can write a clear, useful creative brief for a design/video team without hand-holding

You meet deadlines regardless of time zone

You're organized enough to track 30 accounts without mixing up client names, budgets, or creative



You don't qualify if:

You've only ever managed 1–2 ad accounts at a time

You have no GoHighLevel experience

You're looking for a role where you'll be doing high-level strategy or making budget decisions independently

You get bored easily with repetitive work and are looking for something more "creative" or fast-paced

You've primarily worked with large ad budgets ($10k+/month per account) and are used to aggressive scaling

You need frequent check-ins or hand-holding to stay on task

You're not available to work independently with minimal real-time supervision

You have a history of missing deadlines or going quiet mid-project



Tools you'll use daily: Meta Ads Manager, GoHighLevel, 
, Slack



This is a long-term, ongoing role for the right person — we're not looking for someone who'll do this for a few months and move on. If you thrive on doing the same high-quality process over and over, hitting your numbers, and being someone we can hand a task to and never have to follow up on twice, this is for you.



Fill out the form to send your applications: 

Once you’ve submitted the form, send a message here on OnlineJobs.ph confirming that you’ve completed the application.

title: E-Commerce Operations Assistant (Remote)
description:
Statement Gold is hiring a reliable part-time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant to help manage day-to-day online business operations.



This is a live supervised position. You will be required to stay on Zoom/phone with me or another team member for your ENTIRE 4-hour shift while working. You will receive tasks, complete them live, ask questions when needed, and show progress throughout the shift. Do not apply if you cannot work this way.



Responsibilities



* Manage inventory and product listings on Shopify, TikTok Shop, Etsy, eBay, etc.

* Upload/edit products, photos, descriptions, variants, pricing and inventory

* Create/edit content in Canva Pro

* Post/manage content for Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest

* Help manage our online marketing presence

* Complete administrative and e-commerce tasks as assigned



Hard Requirements:



* $5/hour

* Available at least 4 hours per shift between 8 AM–6 PM Pacific Time

* Must remain live on Zoom/phone for the entire shift

* Advanced Canva Pro skills

* Shopify and Tik Tok Shop experience

* Comfortable using TikTok Shop, Etsy and eBay

* Must own an iPhone

* Strong English and communication

* Reliable internet

* Fast, organized, detail-oriented and able to follow instructions



First week is an evaluation week. If selected, you will have one week to demonstrate reliability, speed, accuracy and skill before continuing long-term.
